description: This file defines a public enumeration 'OpenClawBonjour' containing constants and methods for handling Bonjour/mDNS service types and domains related to 'OpenClaw'. It includes functions for normalizing, resolving, and retrieving service domains, with some internal logic for environment-based configuration.

methods.name: resolveWideAreaDomain
methods.description: Resolves the wide area domain based on environment variable input, normalizing and comparing it to the default service domain.

methods.name: normalizeServiceDomain
methods.description: Normalizes a raw domain string by trimming, lowercasing, and appending a trailing dot if necessary, with special handling for 'local' or empty strings.
